config.note: Percent a year, monthly average of daily quotes, so a month that ends on a spike reads lower than the last day. Series keys are ISO country codes. The US series starts in 1953, the OECD ones in the 1950s to 1980s; all are the benchmark ten-year (or nearest) government bond, which is what 'the yield' means in the press. Nominal: subtract inflation expectations before comparing countries with different inflation
